GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding his riding and if there was an opportunity to maintain a position behind the leader. Rider explained that as the mare was failing to travel as he would have liked, he was of the opinion that he would have had to make use of his mount to maintain his position. For this reason he elected to ease and obtain a trailing position behind a favoured runner. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Trainer advised the mare would now be sent for a spell.
